ecological_question: Does the timescale over which past state remains predictive depend on the ecological state dimension being measured?
working_hypothesis: Historical hypothesis retained for provenance only: coarse persistence was hypothesized to retain longer predictive history than quantitative condition. The stable-site reference audit did not support this as a robust state-dimension contrast.

representation_matched_exponential_repla.primary_tau_selection: Transferred from the already-frozen best tested Tampa binary-state exponential memory result before quantitative replay.
representation_matched_exponential_repla.descriptive_tau_grid: No tested quantitative tau passed the predeclared support rule for either metric.
representation_matched_exponential_repla.interpretation: The coarse-versus-quantitative contrast is not explained simply by using older mean/slope features for quantitative state rather than the exponential-memory representation used for binary state.

not_yet_identified: Which persistent ecological attributes are represented by stable transect identity.
How much of the residual older-history predictive gain is temporal rather than site-specific heterogeneity.
A causal mechanism for Tampa state decoupling or spatially heterogeneous degradation.

prospective_confirmatory_design.candidate_requirement: A response-unopened repeated monitoring system with both a variable coarse presence/persistence state and a quantitative condition state measured on the same stable sampling units over at least five target years.
prospective_confirmatory_design.split: Identical strict walk-forward target-year splits for both state dimensions.
prospective_confirmatory_design.baseline: Same response-independent site/time covariates and stable-unit identity within each state-specific model.
prospective_confirmatory_design.older_history_increment: Use the same exponential all-prior-state operator for both state dimensions, with tau values frozen before response opening. The primary tau must be common across dimensions; state-specific retuning is forbidden.
prospective_confirmatory_design.support_rule: For each state dimension separately, older history is supported only if it wins at least 60% of target years, has negative median paired loss delta versus lag1, and one-sided paired year-level sign-flip p<0.05.
prospective_confirmatory_design.primary_prediction: Historical pre-audit prediction retained for provenance only; not an active confirmatory target.
forbidden: Selecting thresholds after seeing outcomes to manufacture a coarse state.
Changing history representation or tau by state after outcome access.
Retuning tau separately for coarse and quantitative states to favor the hypothesis.
Comparing raw effect magnitudes across incompatible loss functions as if directly commensurate.
Calling the current Tampa/NPS contrast causal confirmation.
prospective_confirmatory_design.withdrawal_reason: Stable transect identity removed formal older-history support in every tested state dimension, so a prospective matched-memory external test is no longer the highest-value gate.

thresholding_only_known_truth_v1.interpretation: Simple lossy thresholding of a first-order quantitative ecological state is not sufficient to explain the empirical coarse-versus-quantitative older-history contrast over the frozen grid.

two_timescale_hidden_state_v1.interpretation: A slow latent AR(1) suitability/persistence state plus faster condition did not reproduce the frozen complete pattern.

latent_occupancy_detection_v1.interpretation: First-order latent occupancy persistence plus imperfect detection produced some binary-biased older-history signal but failed the frozen global sufficiency rule.

superseded_by.reason: The earlier coarse-versus-quantitative older-history contrast was not reference-matched. Adding stable transect identity removes formal older-history support for all three tested state dimensions across the 16-value tau grid.
superseded_by.claim_boundary: Do not use v1 as an active state-dimension-dependent long-memory hypothesis or as justification to open a new external matched-memory response dataset.
